pr_title: Fix the location that selecting a mark uses
pr_body:
I think this subtly regressed in #16611. Jump to https://github.com/microsoft/terminal/commit/90b8bb7c2d8932fc601aed9c26f13c77d5a1321d#diff-f9112caf8cb75e7a48a7b84987724d754181227385fbfcc2cc09a879b1f97c12L171-L223

`Terminal::SelectNewRegion` is the only thing that uses the return value from `Terminal::_ScrollToPoints`. Before that PR, `_ScrollToPoints` was just a part of `SelectNewRegion`, and it moved the start & end coords by the `_VisibleStartIndex`, not the `_scrollOffset`.

Kinda weird there weren't any _other_ tests for `SelectNewRegion`?

I also caught a second bug while I was here - If you had a line with an exact wrap, and tried to select that like with selectOutput, we'd explode.

Closes #17131

issue_context.title: [1.21] Selecting commands, output with the context menu is totally in the wrong place
issue_context.body:
open pwsh, with shell integration enabled

do a 

```
cd Z:\dev\public\OpenConsole\
git status
dir
foo
whatever
```

try and right-click select the output of `dir`, and it's... wrong:

![image](https://github.com/microsoft/terminal/assets/18356694/99bee5a6-5e62-4d8a-8aea-b7d8acf018f6)


surely, I'm the murderer, but I could have swore there were tests for this

review_comments: `DecrementInBounds` has a 2nd parameter `bool allowEndExclusive` which you can set to `true` to fix this.

it doesn't though 😢 `allowEndExclusive` plumbs through to:
https://github.com/microsoft/terminal/blob/8d67477a1a1b6d26669736057f4ef2f318400ac8/src/types/viewport.cpp#L211-L220
https://github.com/microsoft/terminal/blob/8d67477a1a1b6d26669736057f4ef2f318400ac8/src/types/viewport.cpp#L172-L175
https://github.com/microsoft/terminal/blob/8d67477a1a1b6d26669736057f4ef2f318400ac8/src/types/viewport.cpp#L116-L119

In this case, the right is exclusive, but not the bottom. So it fails the check in IsInBounds
Ugh... If you don't mind waiting for a PR from me, I can fix that once and for all for you.
As discussed - we're gonna move ahead with this _less-than-great_ solution for now and fix this in #17143 after 1.22 forks off

Should we also update the comment? It currently reads:
```cpp
// Return Value:
// - The updated scroll offset
```

BTW, as someone new to this repo I have a doubt: what's the mutable viewport? And how does it differ from the viewport that `_scrollOffset` represents? 

Not the best place to ask questions, so I'm sorry 😅

No worries! I probably didn't do the best job with that particular abstraction, and it bites even me to this day.
